title: 01 Matrix
statement: Given a binary matrix, return a matrix of the same size where each cell is the distance to the nearest 0. Distance is 4-directional.
hints: Searching outward from every 1 repeats work.
Multi-source BFS from every 0 assigns distances in increasing order.
Initialize 0-cells to distance 0 and 1-cells to infinity, then relax neighbors.

approaches.name: BFS from each 1
approaches.explanation: Too slow when the matrix is large.

editorial: Enqueue every 0 with distance 0. A 1 starts at infinity and is not a source. When you dequeue a cell, each in-bounds neighbor whose stored distance is larger than yours plus one gets updated and enqueued. Because edges have length 1, the first time a cell is set is its final distance.

examples.explanation: The center is distance 1 from a zero.
Distances grow away from the zeros.
